serving.title: Engines
serving.subtitle: Where Mesbah runs models, and how other tools reach them.
serving.unreachable: This engine isn't answering. Check that it is started and the address is right.

vllm.name: vLLM
vllm.explain: Loads each version beside the base model. It must be able to read Mesbah's data folder.

ollama.name: Ollama
ollama.explain: Runs a version from its GGUF export.

llamacpp.name: llama.cpp
llamacpp.explain: Answers with the one model it serves.

openai.name: OpenAI-compatible
openai.explain: Answers with the one model it serves.

builtin.title: Mesbah's engine
builtin.lead: Built in. It runs the models for chat and training on this machine.
builtin.idle: Nothing is loaded. The first chat in a project loads a model.

stopped.title: The engine is not running.
stopped.body: Chat and training need it. How to start it depends on how Mesbah was installed.
stopped.pipBody: Install the training parts, then start Mesbah again.
stopped.dockerBody: Starts the engine and training on the processor.

free.title: Free the engine's memory?
free.body: The loaded model leaves memory. The next chat loads it again, which takes a while.

others.title: Other engines
others.emptyAdmin: Mesbah's own engine is enough to start. Connect another to use a stronger machine or a server you already have.
others.emptyRead: Mesbah's own engine is enough to start. An administrator can connect others.
others.disconnectBody: Versions can no longer run on it from Mesbah. The engine itself is not changed.

form.name: Name
form.addressInvalid: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://.
form.modelNameHint: The name the engine gives its model. Leave empty if it needs none.
form.apiKeyNone: Leave empty if the engine needs no key.
form.apiKeySaved: A key is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
form.keyRemoved: The key is removed when you save.
form.defaultLocked: This is the default engine. Make another engine the default to change it.

keys.title: API keys
keys.lead: A key lets another tool use Mesbah's models. It works with the role of its owner.
keys.trainersOnlyBody: Trainers and administrators make API keys. Ask one of them if a tool needs one.
keys.emptyBody: Make a key to let another tool use Mesbah.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeBody: Tools using this key stop working at once. This can't be undone.

newKey.title: New API key
newKey.name: Name
newKey.nameHint: What the key is for, such as the tool that uses it.
newKey.warning: This is the only time the key is shown. Copy it and keep it somewhere safe.

guide.title: Use from other tools
guide.lead: Tools and libraries reach Mesbah's models at these addresses. Every request needs an API key.
guide.openaiBody: For tools and libraries made for OpenAI.
guide.ollamaBody: For tools and libraries made for Ollama.
guide.modelsLead: A project's short name is its model name.

copy.failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

errors.builtin_engine_kept: Mesbah's own engine can't be disconnected.
errors.engine_timeout: The engine took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.engine_rejected_token: The engine did not accept the saved API key. Check the key and try again.
errors.engine_failed: The engine couldn't do that. Try again.
errors.no_engine: No engine is available to run models. Turn one on or connect one.
